title: What Really Happens When You Opt Out of Paying Income Taxes?
summary: CPA walks through tax opt-out arguments (voluntary filing, not a person, state citizen, federal zones) and the IRS and court rulings rejecting them.

assertions.quote: income means all income from any source derived, including wages, salaries
the claim that payment of federal income tax is voluntary is without merit
they've been known to pursue criminal charges against those who persist in these claims
The courts have consistently rejected claims that individuals can be state citizens but not US citizens
The IRS's position is that the Internal Revenue Code applies to all US citizens and residents

verdicts.note: Federal statutes and the income tax apply throughout the states; courts reject the federal-zone argument as frivolous.
Courts uniformly reject the argument that the US consists only of DC, territories and enclaves; 7th, 6th, 9th and 11th Circuits called it frivolous and the 16th Amendment tax applies nationwide.

assertions.quote: Arguments that an individual is not a person within the meaning of the Internal Revenue Code have been uniformly rejected.
These arguments don't hold up in legal proceedings
